items.title: Circle shares climb after Q2 results, federal bank charter approval and higher guidance
items.summary: Circle Internet Group (NYSE:CRCL) shares rose around 7% in pre-market trading after the stablecoin issuer reported second-quarter results in line with expectations, secured the first federal bank charter granted to a stablecoin company and raised parts of its full-year outlook. The company also announced that BlackRock, Visa and Mastercard will serve as validators for its upcoming blockchain network.

items.title: Circle jumps 7% in premarket trade after Q2 bank charter, in-line earnings
items.summary: Investing.com -- Shares of Circle Internet Group jumped 7% in premarket trading on Wednesday after the stablecoin issuer reported second-quarter earnings in line with estimates and disclosed it had received the first federal bank charter awarded to a stablecoin company.

items.title: BlackRock To Triple ETHA’s Share Price With Reverse Split: Here’s What Investors Need To Know
items.summary: BlackRock will execute a 1-for-3 reverse split for its spot Ethereum ETF on October 6, with no change to investor ownership or fund value.

items.title: Apollo Global Q2 Earnings Miss Estimates, Expenses Increase Y/Y
items.summary: APO's Q2 results are affected by higher expenses as adjusted net income misses estimates. Higher AUM and revenue growth provide support.

items.title: Ford, Google, and BlackRock Say America Needs Millions More Tradespeople. A 63-Year-Old Electrician Should Know the Overtime Catch.
items.summary: Ford, BlackRock, and Google just pledged hundreds of millions to pull experienced tradespeople back into the workforce, and a 63-year-old electrician in Ohio is answering that call without realizing the bigger paychecks could trigger two separate federal penalties at once.

items.title: Italy’s Largest Bank Cuts BlackRock Bitcoin ETF Stake 94%: Rotation to Ethereum?
items.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo cut its Bitcoin ETF stake 94% and tripled its staked Ethereum holdings. Are institutions ditching Bitcoin for Ethereum?
